description: BOYDS, MD – Today, conservative Robin Ficker is launching his campaign for Congress inMaryland’s Sixth Congressional District, his long-time home. Republicans lost Maryland’s Sixth by just over six percentage points and less than 24,000 votes in 2024, while being outspent nearly 6-1. Robin Ficker pledges to seed his race with a seven-figure contribution to ensure that he can go toe-to-toe ... Read More
